name: sportzone-store-monorepo
description: SportZone Store - Production E-Commerce Fullstack Monorepo

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
